pass_a_gloss: Lord, why were-multiplied the afflicting me? The progressing many the afflicters they-have. But you, Lord, helper of-me you-are, glory of-me and lifting the head of-me. Then is-lifted mind, whenever it-should-apply to-the many-colored of-God wisdom. Of-the holy-one glory the God. Every but of-whom glory is the God, is-lifted by him. The head, that-is of-the soul the rising-up. Just-as for is-lifted head of-the according-to-body having-been-made-large beside the of-the lesser heads below lying, thus also having-risen-up of-the blessed soul, the head is-lifted, God co-working with-it.
pass_b_english: “Lord, why have those who afflict me been multiplied?” (Psalm 3:2). Those who are making progress have many who afflict them.

“But you, Lord, are my helper, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head” (Psalm 3:4). Then the mind is lifted up, whenever it applies itself to the manifold wisdom of God (Ephesians 3:10). The glory of the holy one is God. And everyone whose glory is God is lifted up by him.

The head, that is, the rising of the soul. For just as the head of one who has been made large in body is lifted up above the heads of the lesser ones that lie below, so also, when the soul of the blessed has risen, the head is lifted up, God working with it.

lemmas.gloss: helper / one who takes one's part

choices.term: Οἱ προκόπτοντες πολλοὺς τοὺς θλίβοντας ἔχουσι
choices.english: Those who are making progress have many who afflict them
choices.why: προκόπτοντες are those advancing, not the afflicters. The CF crib inverted this.
rejected: those who oppose me are many
those who progress are the afflicters

choices.term: ὁπηνίκα ἂν ἐπιβάλλῃ τῇ πολυποικίλῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ σοφίᾳ
choices.english: whenever it applies itself to the manifold wisdom of God
choices.why: ἐπιβάλλω here is the mind applying itself; πολυποίκιλος is manifold, not 'opposes the multiplicity'.
rejected: when the divine wisdom of God opposes the multiplicity

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
